source.method: Actual Minecraft 26.3 LayerDefinitions.createRoots geometry and setupAnim rest pose; CPU extraction, no game window or GPU. Renderer external root transforms are excluded.
source.partBindingMethod: Canonical carrier paths, then visible rest-pose parts with closest shared ancestry and an unchanged relative model matrix across rest/moving/action1/action2 poses (tolerance 0.0001). Additional parts require a positive uniform relative scale; noncanonical legs/wings and hidden parts remain guides.

coordinateSystem.note: Use full part model matrix, including ancestor transforms and scales. Convert native block matrix to pixel units before preview conversion. Cube polygon vertices include inflate and mirror; bounds may not include inflate and are not a replacement for face vertices.
